name: Brooklyn Bridge Animal Welfare Coalition (BBAWC) / Brooklyn Cat Cafe
neighborhoods: All of Brooklyn (Kings County) for vetting & fostering support
notes:
501(c)(3) coalition of rescuers (EIN 26-1482964), founded 2007, 8,000+ cats rescued. Not a traditional shelter. Serves all Kings County for vetting/fostering; does NOT run TNR projects itself (refers to Neighborhood Cats/FCI) but runs the BBAWC Rescue Clinic (spay/neuter) inside the Brooklyn Cat Cafe. PO Box 22948, Brooklyn 11202. Other channel: Brooklyn Cat Cafe: (347) 946-2286, 76 Montague St Other channel: catcafebk.com

If you must give up a cat: its rescue page says it can help rehome it, either while you foster it or through its foster network. It asks first for medical records, and the cat to be spayed or neutered, examined, vaccinated and tested. Email help@bbawc.org.

change_log.note: From its own rescue page, read in a browser: "If it's absolutely necessary for you to surrender your pet, we can help you rehome them... please email us at help@bbawc.org."
